tracks.title: Love Is How U Make It

notes.text:
Recorded in France, August 1973 by the Manor Mobile.

Black and white the Roger Dean 'Twins' label. 
Catalog number printed as "V2007" on the back sleeve & spine and as "V2007" on the disc label.

Title of B5 printed as "Love Is How Y Make It" on the back sleeve but as "Love Is How U Make It" on the disc label.
Complete with 14-page booklet with the presentation of "Radio Gnome Invisible".
Also, B12 is given as "I Niver Glid Before" on the sleeve, but "I Never Glid Before" on the label.

On back cover :
Recorded by Manor Mobile 24 track studios chez Gong at Pavillon du Hay in France at full moon August 1973.

The durations printed are incorrect:
Side 1- 1: 8:00 2: 3:00 3: 1:15 4: 5:30 5: 0:50 6: 3:10
Side 2- 7a: 2:40 7b: 3:35 8: 2:00 9: 2:15 10: 0:40 11: 3:00 12: 5:45 13: 3:00

Runouts are positioned as : 
- side A : 
9 o'clock : 1
6 o'clock : V 2007 A-2U
3 o'clock : A

- side B : 
9 o'clock : 1
6 o'clock : V 2007 B-3U
3 o'clock : CD
